publication_pending: Independent candidate review and explicit publication approval.
Push reviewed backend commit/tag and upload the exact retained wheel/source/provenance/notices/checksums; do not rebuild approved bytes.
Empty-cache real public download, checksum verification, fresh dependency install and unset-default verification.
Record publication validation and obtain merge approval; draft stays unmerged.
limitations: One shared M5 Max, 128 GiB; guards cannot prove GPU exclusivity or control thermals. Fresh process is the sampling unit; warmed calls correlate.
Four trajectory processes, two per arm. Timing is descriptive and does not establish universal speedups.
Zero accepted designs and a shared downstream fixture; this is fixed-work harness completion, not accepted-design throughput or scientific-quality evidence.
Generated design PDB and all 140 metric lines are compared before fixture substitution. MPNN samples and relaxed outputs may vary.
Physical footprint includes CPU/native/Metal process allocations; RSS misses some Metal allocations. System pressure/compression/swap include other applications.
Earlier v4/v5 development timings and old attention-control binaries are not relabeled as production measurements.
Fresh Python dependency environments reused read-only model/native assets. Public download remains unvalidated until separately approved publication.
No diagnostic hooks or private dispatch-counter reads are enabled in normal timing. Logical profitability costs are not measured DRAM traffic.
